issues.on_page: State - grants 4,171,200 (p4); spending includes GEER program purchases 429,929 (budget line 'State grants', p5)
issues.issue: GEER is federal relief money passed through the state, so part of 'State - grants' may be federal. The report does not break it down, so a split is not allowed; same for detail[2].detail_category 'other state aid'. A person should check the grant sources.

All spending except capital is put in 'support services' because the statement lists spending by object. The Statement of Activities (p2) lists programs instead (ESU professional development 6,117,284; PowerSchool consortium 992,025; Canvas statewide consortium 1,110,386; Special education projects 685,996; Distance education council 368,492). This is defensible, but some of it could count as instruction. It is a judgment call on 66% of spending.
